summary:
星巴克上季每股盈餘顯著優於預期達0.85美元，儘管營收微幅年減，但獲利能力展現強韌復甦。
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為0.85美元，大幅超越市場預期的0.65美元。
• 成本控制與利潤率改善成效顯著，帶動獲利優於營收表現。
• 整體營收達93.2億美元，年減1.41%，顯示需求面臨一定壓力。
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報呈現「營收微降、獲利大增」的格局，顯示星巴克的成本撙節與營運效率提升策略奏效。對股價中短期而言，超預期的盈餘有助於支撐高達56.98的本益比，提供底部支撐。追蹤指標應聚焦未來幾季的同店銷售額成長率、全球門市擴張計畫及消費者對價格敏感度的變化。

需留意：營收年減顯示全球消費者支出可能放緩或面臨同業激烈競爭。；高達56.98的本益比反映市場已包含較高成長預期，若後續成長動能不足恐面臨估值修正風險。

summary_en:
Starbucks reported EPS significantly beating estimates at $0.85 despite a minor YoY revenue decline, demonstrating resilient profitability.
• EPS came in at $0.85, significantly beating the market expectation of $0.65.
• Effective cost control and margin improvements drove strong profitability despite soft top-line results.
• Total revenue reached $9.32B, down 1.41% YoY, indicating some demand-side pressure.

ai_view_en:
View: The quarter showed a slight revenue drop paired with a strong EPS beat, indicating successful cost-saving and efficiency initiatives. For the near to mid-term, the positive earnings surprise helps justify the high trailing PE of 56.98 and provides a valuation floor. Key metrics to track include upcoming same-store sales growth, global store expansion plans, and consumer price sensitivity.

Watch：Year-over-year revenue decline suggests softening consumer spending or intense competitive pressures.; A high trailing PE of 56.98 prices in aggressive growth expectations, posing valuation adjustment risks if momentum slows.
